title: I Reviewed 100 Job Applications: Here Is What I Found
description:
I went through 100 real UK job applications line by line, and almost every one was making the same 4 mistakes. The average UK job now gets around 140 applications and roughly 75% get zero response, so your CV, cover letter, and LinkedIn profile have about 30 seconds to do their job. This video breaks down the 4 application mistakes killing your response rate and the exact fix for each one.

If you're applying for jobs in the UK and hearing nothing back, this is the application audit nobody gave you. It's for candidates who are qualified but invisible, and it covers your CV bullet points, your cover letter opener, your LinkedIn keywords, and why sending more applications is making it worse.


What you'll learn in this video:
- Why the average UK job gets 140 applications and how the 30-second recruiter scan decides your fate
- The CV mistake on 8 out of 10 applications and the one question that gets you 40% more callbacks
- The cover letter opening line that kills your application before your CV is even opened
- How recruiters use Boolean search on LinkedIn and the 15-minute fix that puts you at the top
- Why sending more applications lowers your odds and what to do instead to land interviews


VIDEO CHAPTERS:
0:00 I audited 100 UK job applications
0:39 Why UK hiring is broken (140 per role)
2:05 Free UK decision-maker contact list
2:22 Mistake 1: your CV is a list of duties
4:35 Mistake 2: your cover letter opening line
6:35 Mistake 3: LinkedIn and Boolean search
8:02 Mistake 4: the volume trap
9:52 The system underneath the 4 fixes
11:36 What to do next


Stop playing the volume game and start playing the specificity game. Here's where to start:

FREE CAREER DIAGNOSTIC
Take my career diagnostic: https://offeraccelerator.co.uk/join-free-training-organic?source=youtube


CONNECT WITH ME
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/olivercordingley
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/olivercordingley


WATCH NEXT:
The UK Job Market Just Broke (What's Next)


ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
